score_units: IoU/recall fractions in JSON; percentage points in Markdown; MAE seconds; memory allocated bytes
aggregation: Equal-query main table; separate parent-level and parent-cluster paired estimates. Current development selection is disclosed and is not online label access.

efficiency.interpretation: Actual resident-run query wall includes the expert work actually executed and cache hits. Source224 is a component, not a separately measured Source end-to-end baseline. Complete peak is max(worker allocated CUDA peak, teacher/capture allocated CUDA peak), not their sum; cold uncached latency is not inferred. Reused predictions retain their original measured inference cost, not materialization time; their count is reported separately.
